title: The Ante House Blues
motive_summary: An overwhelming debt stemming from a high-stakes, secret gambling game that threatened to ruin one's entire life.
overview_text: The body of Elias Grant was discovered in the back office of 'Priya's Flat' by Owen Price. The victim lay sprawled on a faded Persian rug, having succumbed to trauma inflicted by a heavy-bladed object identified as the 'Brass till weight'. There were no signs of forced entry, suggesting the victim knew the killer or was lured there under false pretenses. A scattered mess of chips and empty whiskey glasses suggested a recent, volatile encounter.
